captions: Give a certificate to everyone who fills in your Google Form, like a feedback form at the end of a workshop.
Build your form as usual. Add a Name question and an Email question, and make both required. Then add any other questions you like.
On the Responses tab, choose Link to Sheets, and create a new spreadsheet.
Every answer now lands as a row in that sheet.
Add the Sert trust script to this sheet, exactly as in our Google Sheets guide, and connect it with your A P I key.
Then choose Sert trust, Turn on automatic issuing. From now on, every form submission is issued straight away.
A participant fills in the form, and submits it.
Within a minute, their row says Issued, with a link to the certificate,
and the certificate is already in their inbox. Set it up at sert trust dot app.
